# J2 INTSUM 01, JTF BEACON

> UNCLASSIFIED // EXERCISE // FICTIONAL DATA

## Period

D-7 0000 to D-4 1800.

## Significant activity

- 1-41 MECH is digging in along PL COPPER north of Ashby Ford, with obstacles at the ford's north exit: PR-11 (B2).
- About 25 vehicles in hides east of Port Calder (2-41 MECH) and four tracked vehicles in revetments on Harrow Ridge: IM-04 (B3).
- A video of tanks on the Harrow Ridge track: OS-02 (C3). OS-03 (C3) repeats the same video and adds nothing; it is not a second source.
- An unidentified fast craft stopped twice in the eastern channel at night: MP-05 (C3). A fishing skipper describes something similar: FR-01 (ungraded).

## Assessment of intent

41 CSTL BDE is likely to delay forward of PL COPPER and then defend Port Calder. It is unlikely to give up the harbour without a fight.

## Changes since last

First INTSUM of the exercise.

## Gaps

- Whether the eastern channel of the Varn Strait is mined: nothing reports mines laid and nothing reports it clear.
- Whether the vehicles on Harrow Ridge are tanks.
